text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr brilliantly achieved great 
results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Zephyr-san, right? I believe I saw 
her over by the park.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... You've got it tough, Trainer. 
Zephyr-san really is just—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"She always has that 'free spirit' vibe 
going on, it's so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right! I really admire that fluffy, gentle 
vibe~.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Trainer? Have you surrendered to 
the breeze's pillow too?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Feeling the breeze sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A timely breeze, isn't it? The rustling 
east wind brings us pleasant weather.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list:
No, I was just thinking that Zephyr never 
changes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has accomplished great things over 
these three years. Of course, she's grown 
and changed, but at her core, she remains 
the exact same as she was back then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's right. For I am the wind. I 
am always blowing across the land, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Always, freely. To anywhere and 
everywhere—
